messages:
elaine (marketing): Final prep for tomorrow's announcement. Need final changelog link, canonical docs URLs, bench snapshot for the post, canary timing, and a console screenshot. Also want to A/B test two hero CTAs. Who can pick up each item? :wave:

mike (eng): Changelog: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/compare/v1.9.8...v1.10.0. Note: router fallback behavior added.

jordan (product): Reviewing release notes now. For webinar routing, use SFDC campaign `Launch-Q2-2026` unless marketing wants a separate campaign.

lee (docs): Docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/getting-started and https://docs.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-q2-2026. Added JS and Python quickstarts. I can add a small snippet showing `quantized: true`.

elaine (marketing): Yes please add quantized sample. Marketing needs median/p95 latency and a rough cost-per-1k tokens for the blog.

mike (eng): Bench numbers (dedicated pool): median = 44ms/token, p95 = 195ms/token. Cost approx $0.00195 per 1k tokens with current batching. CSV: https://internal.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-q2-2026.csv

sam (ops): Proposed canary: start 09:35 PT smoke @5% for 10m, ramp 09:50 PT to 30% for 20m, full at 10:20 PT. Rollback triggers: >0.9% error-rate sustained for 4m OR p95 > 700ms for 3 consecutive 60s windows. I will own watch.

elaine (marketing): Can smoke be 09:30 so screenshot available ~10:05? Need it redacted for the blog.

sam (ops): Sure, bump smoke to 09:30. I'll enable a short-lived public snapshot link for screenshot: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/launch-q2/snapshot-10am (expires +2h).

lee (docs): I'll grab and redact the screenshot after smoke and upload to Confluence.

mike (eng): Deploy commands: ```
helm upgrade --install redwood-serve ./charts/serve --set image.tag=launch-q2-canary --namespace prod
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled at 1778889000. Image gcr.io/redwood/serve:launch-q2-canary. Log stream: https://deploy-logs.redwood.ai/1778889000

jordan (product): Webinar leads 1: map to `Launch-Q2-2026` campaign; webhook routes to marketing@redwood.ai. If marketing wants a separate nurture list, say now.

elaine (marketing): Keep the campaign. A/B hero CTAs: A) "Predictable LLM serving with measurable unit economics" B) "Lower latency, lower cost: inference tuned for production". Jordan, pick variant by EOD pls.

mike (eng): Quick heads-up for docs: cold-KV warmup can add ~120-180ms to early tokens for long sequences; ops warming job reduces it. We'll mention this under Known Behaviors.

sam (ops): Noted. I'll monitor and will trigger automated rollback via deploy-bot if thresholds hit. Also enabling a temporary throttle cap at 85% CPU for first hour after full traffic.

elaine (marketing): Final checklist: changelog link (mike)  705, docs links + screenshot (lee)  pending screenshot, bench numbers (mike)  705, canary timing & ops contact (sam)  705, webinar routing (jordan)  pending headline pick. Blog scheduled 11:00 PT with changelog + docs + bench table + CTA + webinar link. If anything changes, ping @elaine here or DM. Thanks team! :rocket:
